rubrics.justification: Core description matches the provided 3AA grading and typical Day 5 expanded blastocyst features, but it adds speculative image findings such as central vacuoles/bubbles that may not be clearly supported.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrium, and cycle history with embryo quality well, though some links (stress, alcohol, sperm motility impact) are somewhat overstated.
The response is organized and mostly logical, but the probability adjustments are somewhat arbitrary and it double-counts aneuploidy risk after already starting from a morphology-based baseline.

Much of the embryo grading and general counseling is aligned with IVF practice, but recommendations such as routine low-dose aspirin for BMI >30, strong emphasis on PGT-A after one failure, and ERA after 2 failed transfers are not standard guideline-based recommendations.
Provides clear next steps for transfer counseling and future planning, but some recommendations are more aggressive than evidence supports and would benefit from greater nuance.
